at  appearance  of  menstruation,  followed  by  yellowish
leucorrhoea.
Pain  in  uterus,  with  pain  in  small  of  back,  very  violent,

Dragging  in  genitals,  with  more  violent  backache  than

she  had  ever  had  before.
Stitches  in  region  of  uterus  and  genitals.
Menses  too  early  and  painful.

tickling  in  larynx,  producing  dry  cough,  <  lying  down,

■  Cough  with  abundant  thick  expectoration;  accompanied
by  weakness  of  digestive  tract,  general  languor  and  de-

Tearing  in  palm  of  1.  hand,  unable  to  double  fingers.

temple;  sticking  above  r.  eyebrow.

Night:  toothache  <  ;  tickling  in  larynx  <;  cramp  in  calves.

^^  Attacks.     Periodicity.     Ten  times  in  one  hour:  urging  to

urinate.
*"  Locality  and  Direction.  Right:  sticking  headache;  tran-
sient sticking  above  eyebrow;  stitches  in  side  of  middle
of  nose;  sticking  side  of  umbilicus;  cutting  between
umbilicus  and  groin;  transient  pain  in  scapula;  stitches

tween seventh  and  eighth  rib;  tearing,  cramp-like  pain
in  tip  of  shoulder,  in  muscles  of  side  of  neck;  tearing  in

Right  then  left:  headache.
